Let me analyze this OIML certificate.

Certificate: R60/2000-NL1-05.02, Netherlands, project number 501454, page 1 of 2. Date issued: 17 March 2005.

Issuing authority: NMi Certin B.V., Hugo de Grootplein 1, Dordrecht. Person responsible: Ing. C. Oosterman, Manager Product Certification. Phone: +31 78 6332332 (NMi general). The NMi address is Hugo de Grootplein 1, 3314 EG Dordrecht. Website: not present.

Applicant: Mettler-Toledo (Changzhou) Precision Instrument Ltd., No. 5 Middel Huashan Road, Sanjing Industry Park, XinBei, Distric, ChangZhou, Jiang Su, 213022, P.R. China.

Manufacturer: same.

Certified type: SBH and SBH (Ab) — load cells (R60 is load cells). Fraction Pi = 0.7, temperature range -10°C/+40°C, Emax 0.25 t up to and including 2 t (range!), Accuracy class C, n = 3000, Y = Emax/Vmin = 10000.

The Emax is a range: "0.25 t up to and including 2 t". This is a range of capacities, not discrete models. So for maximum_capacity: value {min: 0.25, max: 2}, unit_symbol "t". This is a range — I could treat it as a single type-level characteristic with min/max, since it's a continuous range, not discrete models. The type designations: SBH, SBH (Ab).

Category: "Load cell". Module designation: for R60 — "Analog load cell"? Not stated in the cert; leave null or omit.

Scheme: A (certificate of conformity, R60 scheme A). The certificate says "OIML CERTIFICATE OF CONFORMITY" — scheme A. Include scheme: "A".

Test reports: 
- R60/2000-NL1-04.05, 40 pages
- R60/2000-NL1-04.41, 38 pages
- R60/2000-NL1-05.02A, 38 pages
- R60/2000-NL1-05.02B, 37 pages
Role: type_evaluation_report.

Also mentioned: TC5999 test certificate / description — "the test certificate and the description with number TC5999 and the appertaining documentation folder". Include in test_reports as documentation_file? The role "documentation_file" fits for the description. I could include {"id": "TC5999", "role": "documentation_file"}.

Recommendation: id "R60", edition 2000, scheme "A", accuracy_classes ["C"].

Revision history: not present.

Footnotes: none.

Characteristics type_level:
- fraction_pi: 0.7, dimensionless
- temperature_range: {min: -10, max: 40}, °C
- maximum_capacity: {min: 0.25, max: 2}, "t"
- accuracy_class: "C" — but also in recommendation accuracy_classes. Could include as characteristic. Hmm. I'll include it in recommendation only; but schema example doesn't show accuracy class in characteristics. I'll keep recommendation accuracy_classes ["C"].
- max_number_of_load_cell_intervals_n: 3000
- ratio_y_emax_over_vmin: 10000

No model family needed — it's a continuous Emax range, not discrete models. Though "SBH and SBH (Ab)" are two type designations. The certificate covers two types: SBH and SBH (Ab). Since >1 type variant... but model_family is for model variants with varying attributes; here attributes don't vary per listed type. I'll keep it simple: type_designations ["SBH", "SBH (Ab)"], no model_family.

Date issued: 17 March 2005 → "2005-03-17".

oiml_issuer_id: not present.

Now output JSON.

Address lines for issuing authority: ["Hugo de Grootplein 1", "3314 EG Dordrecht"]. The issuing authority block says "Hugo de Grootplein 1, Dordrecht". The footer says "Hugo de Grootplein 1, 3314 EG Dordrecht". Use both lines.

Phone: +31 78 6332332. Email: none. Website: none.

Certificate number: "R60/2000-NL1-05.02". member_state: "The Netherlands". page_total: 2.
